Subject: Consolidating observability add-on costs & dashboard scope for FinStream

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion I attached the FinStream_PRICING_REQ_v2.pdf with the usage examples you shared. Quick summary of what we heard: 1) retention needs for logs/metrics ~90d but spikes to 365d for compliance windows, 2) high-fidelity traces for 10% of requests, and 3) a small set of advanced dashboards (~12) used by platform and SRE.

Two asks from our side to build a concise quote:
- Can you confirm an average daily ingest for traces/metrics (approx events/day) and whether long-term archival needs to be searchable vs cold storage?
- Procurement would like a single consolidated SKU (retention + tracing + dashboards) if possible — is there a preferred way you consume invoices (monthly vs quarterly)?

We can prepare a consolidated offer with a pilot package (6 weeks, reduced token/ingest credits) and two commitment paths: a 12-month discounted slab or a 3-month pilot-to-commit flow. Attaching the pricing request doc.

I copied our pricing and product leads to keep this tight on scope.

Thanks —

Thanks, received the doc and reviewed with the SRE manager. A few clarifications before you prepare the quote:
- Retention: For the 365d window, we need index/searching for up to 180d, then cold archive for the remainder.

- Dashboards: 12 dashboards but 3 are heavy (multiple panels + streaming queries). We prefer monthly billing but procurement says they prefer consolidated quarterly invoices for enterprise vendors.

Procurement looped in to confirm PO process and legal timelines. Can you include a sample invoice layout and a one-page pilot SOW?

Naomi / team —

Draft pricing sketch below (list rates are example; final numbers in attached spreadsheet observability-addons-sku.xlsx):

1) Retention (searchable):
- 0-50TB/mo: $0.80/GB-month
- 50-200TB/mo: $0.60/GB-month
- 200+ TB/mo: contact sales
- Cold archive (181-365d): $0.12/GB-month (non-searchable)

2) Tracing:
- High-fidelity tier (10% sampling target): $0.045 / trace (includes KV cache optimizations)
- Adaptive sampling recommended to keep billability under 1.3M traces/mo equivalent during peaks

3) Advanced dashboards:
- Standard dashboard: $150 / dashboard / month (first 10)
- Heavy dashboard: $500 / dashboard / month (streaming + many panels)

Discounting options:
A) 12-month commit: 22% off across retention + tracing + dashboards; quarterly consolidated invoice option available.
B) Pilot (6 weeks): 30% off for pilot period in exchange for PO to convert to a 12-month commit within 45 days; convert credit equals 75% of pilot fees applied to first 3 months.

Pilot SOW items (one-pager): onboarding, baseline latency/cost, tracing fidelity validation, dashboard stress tests, pilot report and recommended commit level.

I attached the SKU spreadsheet and a sample one-page pilot SOW.

Couple product notes to include in the quote:
- Recommend adaptive trace sampling + prefix cache for FinStream to hit fidelity target (~10%) while smoothing monthly cost volatility. We'll supply a sampling policy template they can enable during pilot.
- Offer a seatless retention slab (metered GB-month) with an overage smoothing buffer for first 2 quarters to reduce sticker shock. This pairs well with quarterly consolidated invoicing.
- For dashboards: suggest bundling 3 heavy dashboards into an "interactive panel pack" at a 20% bundle discount rather than per-dashboard pricing.

I'll prepare a short paragraph describing these trade-offs for the SOW and flag any SLA implications (longer retention searchable layers add index rebuild costs).
